title: How Kon-Tiki launched a worldwide age of experimental seafaring
lineage: Custodian museum retrospective based on expedition/archive material; the 1970 first-person account below is stronger evidence for the specific construction changes.

passages.locator: Ra and Ra II section, lines 292–300 in live rendered page
passages.note: Explains that Ra I’s waterlogging, steering and structural problems informed changes by Aymara builders for Ra II; Ra II crossed, treating the voyage pair as experimental archaeology.
States experimental voyages could produce useful observations, while successful crossings establish possibility rather than prove ancient contacts.
